concept: Synthetic demo, not a creative default: a paper boat must carry a note across a rain puddle to a waiting snail.

setup.premise: A paper boat must carry a note across a rain puddle to a waiting snail.
setup.avoid: Peril that feels real or sad
setup.lead: A stubborn paper boat that wants to deliver its note
setup.setting: A sidewalk puddle just after rain, late afternoon
setup.hook: Huge effort for a tiny delivery, and the snail takes its time replying

purpose: Show that small persistence wins against bigger obstacles.
audience: Short-form viewers who enjoy tiny-world comedy

target_action.cue: End caption: Part 2 — the snail's reply

structure.why: Persistence only reads when something actively pushes back; the payoff earns the follow.

elements.why: An active blocker makes the boat's persistence visible.
An unopened reply gives a reason to follow for part 2.

beats.event: The boat launches with the folded note on deck.
A gust spins the boat back toward shore.
beats.obstacle: The wind actively pushes the boat backwards.

beats.event: A frog plants itself in the boat's path and swats at the note.
beats.obstacle: The frog blocks the route and tries to knock the note off.

beats.event: The boat rides the frog's splash over it and docks beside the snail.
The snail reads the note and slides a sealed reply back aboard.
